requests.required_source: International Energy Agency rare-earth supply-chain publication cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Official chart or table showing the stated 2024 magnet rare-earth mining/refining/manufacturing concentration values.
requests.acceptance: Institution, publication title, publication date, page/figure identity, direct URL, SHA-256, and highlighted rows are recorded.

requests.required_source: Official IEA or named government chronology cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Dated export-control events directly supporting the narration.
requests.acceptance: Every shown date is visible in the source and fingerprinted by document, page, and region.

requests.required_source: JAMSTEC official project result and schedule material cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Completed milestone and planned recovery/processing stages with dates.
requests.acceptance: Completed and planned stages are visually distinguished without altering the source.

requests.required_source: United Nations official UNCLOS text and official Area map
requests.required_content: Articles 136 and 137 plus the directly relevant official geographic context.
requests.acceptance: UN institution, treaty title, adoption date, page/article, direct URL, checksum, and highlighted clauses are recorded.

requests.required_source: White House Executive Order and NOAA official deep-seabed permit/application pages cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: The parallel legal route, order date, and commercial recovery permit status.
requests.acceptance: Each document/page has institution, title, date, URL, checksum, content identity, and exact highlighted status language.

requests.required_source: The Metals Company lifecycle material cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: The company's stated environmental/lifecycle comparison.
requests.acceptance: The interested-party source is labeled on screen; title, access date, URL, checksum, and highlighted claim are recorded.

requests.required_source: IEA official mineral-demand/technology chemistry table cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Rows showing that different battery chemistries require different mineral inputs.
requests.acceptance: Table cells remain legible on mobile and each crop has a distinct page-region content identity.

requests.required_source: Nature study cited for forty-four-year track persistence
requests.required_content: Original track image/figure, persistence result, and the historical-versus-modern equipment limitation.
requests.acceptance: Journal, paper title, publication date, DOI/URL, figure/page, checksum, and highlighted regions are recorded; distinct crops count once unless content identity differs.

requests.required_source: Nature Ecology & Evolution industrial deep-sea mining trial paper cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Original density/richness figure and sampling context.
requests.acceptance: Exact values, units, time window, sample context, publication identity, and provenance are visible or recorded.

requests.required_source: Nature Communications plume-monitoring paper cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Original plume map, transport measurement, decline curve, and limitations.
requests.acceptance: Figure number, publication date, units, region, DOI/URL, checksum, and highlighted data points are recorded.

requests.required_source: Nature Communications midwater discharge study cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Original experimental or food-web figure showing particle-quality and organism effects.
requests.acceptance: The figure's experimental grain and limitations are preserved; institution/title/date/DOI/checksum are recorded.

requests.required_source: JAMSTEC official milestone material cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Verified technical capability and the boundary between demonstration and future decision.
requests.acceptance: The captured region supports capability only and does not visually imply a commercial commitment.

requests.required_source: IEA official supply-chain material cited in the evidence map
requests.required_content: Distinct supply-chain stages supporting the distributed-risk conclusion.
requests.acceptance: The actual source figure or table is used with highlighted stages and full provenance.

requests.required_content: A real, institution-identified deep-sea mining machine that grounds the engineering process without being misattributed to TMC.
requests.acceptance: Official JAMSTEC source, machine identity, date, provenance and visible source label pass; the image is explicitly not presented as TMC hardware.

requests.required_content: Scientific ROV/AUV observation of a deep-sea track or directly comparable benthic survey.
requests.acceptance: Vehicle type and scientific context are verifiable; no recreational diver or unrelated coral footage.

requests.required_content: Marine plume/sediment sampling or instrument deployment directly related to measurement.
requests.acceptance: The physical measurement link is visible and documented; footage is not treated as the numerical evidence.

requests.required_content: Marine midwater sampling, particle experiment, or food-web observation tied to the narrated mechanism.
requests.acceptance: The marine context and experimental purpose are identifiable; no unrelated bench-lab footage.

requests.required_content: A real marine-science assessment or field-decision process where competing evidence is physically present.
requests.acceptance: Participants or documented field operations, instruments, and expedition setting establish the decision context; provenance does not claim a named meeting unless verified.

requests.required_content: Verified Chikyu expedition identity from the official JAMSTEC 2026 release, directly connected to the precedent sequence.
requests.acceptance: Vessel identity, official institution, release date, source URL and local checksum are recorded and visibly labelled.

requests.required_content: A verified wide view of terrestrial extraction exactly where narration pivots from concentrated mineral demand to land-mining costs.
requests.acceptance: Asset and contact-sheet checksums, reviewed frames, exact narration anchor and claim-specific semantic rationale are recorded.
